content.value_statement: Influencer campaign results often sit across platform exports, creator reports, web analytics, and sales data. This skill turns those inputs into scorecards, rankings, attribution notes, and next-step recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Scores reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, conversions, and revenue against targets and benchmarks.
Compares platforms, creators, content formats, themes, hooks, and calls to action.
Reviews engagement quality, comment sentiment, and purchase-intent signals.
Breaks down attribution by promo codes, UTM tracking, direct attribution, and estimated influence.
Produces ranked learnings, renewal recommendations, and handoff notes for ROI analysis.
limitations: Requires user-provided metrics, exports, screenshots, or authorized connector data.
Does not invent missing benchmarks or fill gaps without labels.
Does not compute final dollar-level ROI rollups; use the ROI calculator for that work.
Winner claims depend on sample size, tracking quality, and significance checks.

use_cases.title: Report campaign performance
use_cases.description: Turn messy post-campaign exports into a clear performance summary with target deltas and ranked learnings.

use_cases.title: Compare creator results
use_cases.description: Rank creators by reach, engagement quality, clicks, conversions, and renewal potential.

use_cases.title: Prepare client recommendations
use_cases.description: Convert campaign metrics into platform mix, content format, and budget guidance for the next brief.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze performance for [campaign name]. I will provide platform metrics, creator reports, targets, and conversion data.

prompt_templates.title: Compare creators
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these creators for [campaign name]: [handles]. Rank them by reach, engagement quality, clicks, conversions, and renewal fit.

prompt_templates.title: Find winning content
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze content performance for [campaign name]. Identify the best formats, hooks, themes, visuals, and calls to action.

prompt_templates.title: Build attribution readout
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze conversion attribution for [campaign name]. Separate promo code, UTM, direct, and estimated influence results, then recommend next tests.

output_examples.input: A summer skincare campaign with Instagram and TikTok exports, creator screenshots, and promo-code sales.
output_examples.output: A campaign scorecard with target deltas, platform ranking, top creators, content learnings, and renewal recommendations.

output_examples.input: Five creators with reach, engagement rate, link clicks, conversion counts, and campaign averages.
output_examples.output: A ranked creator comparison with performance reasons, underperformer diagnosis, and keep, expand, or replace recommendations.

output_examples.input: Traffic, promo-code, and sales data that do not agree across sources.
output_examples.output: An attribution readout that labels source quality, separates methods, explains gaps, and lists follow-up measurement checks.

best_practices: Label each metric as measured, creator-provided, estimated, or benchmarked.
Set targets and comparison periods before ranking creators or platforms.
Mark small-sample wins as keep-testing until they clear the significance bar.
anti_patterns: Do not treat screenshots and API exports as equally reliable without source labels.
Do not declare winners from tiny samples or incomplete tracking.
Do not use this skill for final ROI rollups when the ROI calculator is required.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide platform exports, creator reports, campaign targets, web analytics, promo-code data, sales data, and date ranges.

faq.question: Can it work without live integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the available metrics or screenshots, and the skill will label gaps and ask for missing inputs.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROI?
faq.answer: It prepares ROI inputs and directional reads. Use the ROI calculator for final dollar-level return math.

faq.question: Can it compare platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares platforms by reach, engagement, clicks, conversions, CPA, formats, and campaign fit.

faq.question: How does it handle attribution gaps?
faq.answer: It separates promo code, UTM, direct, and estimated influence results, then explains confidence and missing data.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Brand marketers, influencer managers, agency analysts, and growth teams can use it for campaign measurement.
